chapter: Records, dances and Blanche Calloway (repeated passages)
title: The Lester Young record date and illness with pneumonia and ulcer
summary: He made records with Lester in California and then got sick with pneumonia twice and an ulcer, which kept him out of playing for a while.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: You made those records with Lester in California in '45 I guess. That was for Norman Brands (PHONETIC) wasn't it?
Yeah. Yeah. Right after that I got sick so I didn't know whether Norman wanted me to stay with the group or not. I wasn't able to anyway. So that was that.
Oh yeah, you're thinking of the '56 date are you?
The one with Roy and Ted in the Village.
I start getting sick right after that. Of course I had pneumonia twice. Pneumonia. And after that I got this ulcer in the stomach which I didn't know was an ulcer.
So that kept you out of playing for awhile.
Oh I don't know. From the time I was -- well while I was healing -- I guess when I got my back -- while it was healing.
